before.name: Jonson Miller
before.description: Jonson Miller *1975, Blacksburg, VA, but originally from Johnstown, PA. Virginia Tech graduate student studying the history, sociology, and politics of science and technology. BS and MS in Geology from West Virginia University and the University of Wisconsin-Madison. I play bass guitar in an experimental, improvisational punk band. Sentenced on 2/10/03 to 2 months federal prison (self-report), $500 fine. This custody record is documented by the SOA Watch Austin prisoner chronology: https://www.soaw-austin.org/POC1983_2012.php
